# efelant

Efelant is a PostgreSQL-native communication platform.
Core is SQL. No application server. REST/gRPC are PostgreSQL extensions.

Docs:
- /docs/ Introduction
- /docs/quickstart.html
- /docs/use-cases.html
- /docs/embedding.html
- /docs/sdk.html
- /docs/styles.html
- /docs/api.html
- /docs/specs/openapi.json
- /docs/specs/efelant.proto
- /docs/deployment.html Self-host (Docker, Compose, Swarm, Helm, Kustomize)
- /docs/status.html
- /docs/security.html
- /docs/changelog.html
- /docs/license.html

Rebuild tokens and SDKs from the repo root:
./scripts/packages.sh
